text:
maya: RC candidate ready for pin. Contains hotfix for KV cache OOM + small decoder perf tweak. Requesting pin to 2026-03-20-rc-16 and canary window this morning (09:30-10:00 UTC). artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/rc-16.zip

deploy-bot: build ✅ all checks passed. SHA: 9f3b2d7. artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood/rc-16.zip. CI: unit/integration/smoke started.

liam: quick summary of user-facing changes?

maya: user impact: fewer transient 5xx on long-context requests, slightly lower tail latency for chat. No schema changes.

ana: late in the cycle I pushed a tiny fix to KV eviction edge-case (commit 9f3b2d7 -> 4a1c8e0). Rebuilt artifact and bumped package version. Please re-run smoke before pin.

deploy-bot: smoke job requeued by @ana. smoke-run-2148801150: running...

qa-bot: smoke results: basic flows ✅, auth flows ✅, streaming ✅, reindex integration flaky (1/3 failures): see logs snippet:
```
ERR: reindex task timeout after 60s - retry 2/3
Stack: ...
```

jamie: I reproduced the reindex flap locally. Pushed a tiny backoff tweak to make reindex tolerant (commit 7d2e9fc). Triggered rebuild -> new artifact at s3://redwood-artifacts/rc-16.1.zip (SHA 7d2e9fc).

liam: if rc changes commits we should update the release note and pin to a final RC id. Are we calling this rc-16.1 or promote as rc-17?

maya: let's keep semantics simple: pin rc-16 (final) with artifact SHA 7d2e9fc. I'll note the late fix in release notes. Re-run smoke and canary after pin.

deploy-bot: smoke-run-2148801300: all smoke checks ✅ (including reindex). Integration backlog shows no failures.

sheriff: rollback plan: on prod canary, if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR error budget burn > 5%/10m => immediate rollback to rc-15. Rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback --target=rc-15 --env=prod --reason="canary-thresholds-hit"
```
Also notify #incidents and page oncall if 5xx > 1%.

oncall: oncall (me) will be watching the canary window. Runbook ready: steps for swift rollback and traffic shift. I have console access and will coordinate.

liam: docs/release-notes snippet for this RC?

maya: release-notes bullet points:
- Fixed KV cache eviction edge-case that caused OOMs under long-context serving.
- Increased reindex resilience (backoff) to avoid transient failures.
- Decoder performance micro-optimization reduces p95 by ~8% on medium-length prompts.

jamie: LGTM for notes.

deploy-bot: pin request received. Pinning rc-16 -> artifact SHA 7d2e9fc. Pinned by maya at 2148801400. Promotion scheduled: 2026-03-20 09:30 UTC canary (10% for 10m) then progressive ramp to 100% over 30m if health OK.

maya: approving promotion. @sheriff any last blockers? :eyes:

sheriff: +1 conditional on thresholds in message above. I'll sign off to proceed.

deploy-bot: promotion started at 2148801600. Canary traffic 10% -> monitoring dashboards enabled.

oncall: watching metrics, ready to run rollback command if thresholds breached.

deploy-bot: canary health at +6m: 5xx=0.12% (<0.5%), p95=320ms (<350ms). Continuing ramp.

deploy-bot: promotion complete at 2148801820. 100% traffic now on rc-16. No rollback executed.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a brief post to #release-notes and update the changelog. :tada:
